title: My Room is a Dungeon Rest Stop
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Touru rents a suspiciously cheap apartment whose front door opens into a dungeon in another world. He rescues Ria, a poisoned knight separated from her party, and she mistakes him for a great sage because everyday things like running water and cola work like magic potions. A seven-volume comedy based on a novel, mixing dungeon adventure with apartment-sharing romance and fan service.
life_message: Ordinary kindness and modern comforts can make an unremarkable young man a hero to someone else.

content.note: Poisoning and dungeon monsters such as slimes; ANN describes combat as mild.
Ecchi genre, Big Breasts and cohabitation (MangaUpdates), MangaDex suggestive; ANN vol. 1 notes a sexy design but no nudity; later volumes unknown (to verify).
Taking a stranger home (ANN notes the awkward trust).
Snack foods as potions are a running gag.

dominant: Wish-fulfilment comedy; fan-service romance; modern goods as magic

folkways.japan: Uses the Japanese 'reverse isekai' formula and the six-tatami apartment setting typical of young adults in Japanese cities.

winners_losers: Touru gains an admiring companion and adventure; no ideological opponent; sympathy is with Touru and Ria.
